description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams used for filtering employee supervisor search results. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifically contains an employee number property with getter and setter methods, along with a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object used for specifying filter parameters in employee supervisor search functionalities, including an employee number and sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object with a default sort field of 'supervisor.lastName'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.
